title: What if Stanford was in Boston? (photoreal stills cut)
style: Photorealistic stills animated with camera moves, word-by-word captions, AI narrator. Tone: realistic and funny; jokes come from plausible side effects, no cartoon props. Stills: Higgsfield z_image (free plan). Narrator: Higgsfield seed_audio, preset voice Reid.
imagePrefix: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photograph, natural light, shot on a full-frame camera, 35mm lens, realistic textures, no text, no logos, no watermark.

shots.narration: What if Stanford was in Boston?
shots.image: A surprised college student in a red hoodie and shorts stands in falling snow in the foreground, looking back over her shoulder in disbelief; behind her, slightly out of focus, Stanford's sandstone Hoover Tower rises among red-brick Boston rowhouses and a grey winter sky. Snow on her shoulders.

shots.narration: This is Stanford, in sunny Palo Alto, California.
shots.image: Aerial drone photograph of Stanford University's Main Quad and Hoover Tower on a bright sunny California afternoon, sandstone arcades, red clay tile roofs, palm trees, golden hills in the distance, blue sky.

shots.narration: Palm trees, red-tile roofs, and basically zero snow.
shots.image: Low eye-level photograph walking down Stanford's Palm Drive, rows of tall palm trees, students on bicycles, sandstone buildings with red tile roofs, warm sunlight, people in t-shirts and sunglasses.

shots.narration: Now imagine the whole campus lifting off.
shots.image: Wide realistic photograph of the entire Stanford Main Quad and Hoover Tower hovering a few meters above torn-up ground, huge cracked chunk of earth and roots hanging underneath, dust cloud, a few stunned students with phones filming from the grass in the foreground, sunny California sky. Looks like a real news photo.

shots.narration: It flies two thousand six hundred ninety miles across the country.
shots.image: (not generated: drawn from real US outlines, us-atlas 3.0.1 states-albers-10m, ISC licence)
shots.caption: It flies 2,690 miles across the country.

shots.narration: And lands in Boston, right on the Charles River.
shots.image: Realistic photograph across the Charles River in Boston in winter: Stanford's sandstone Hoover Tower and red-tile-roofed quad now sit on the riverbank among Boston brick buildings, a cloud of snow and dust from the landing still settling, Boston skyline behind, rowers on the river staring, light snowfall.

shots.narration: Problem one. Boston gets about forty nine inches of snow a year.
shots.image: Realistic photograph of Stanford's red clay tile roofs and sandstone arches buried under deep snow, palm trees bent and drooping under heavy snow, a shivering student in shorts and flip-flops with arms crossed in the foreground, grey Boston winter light.
shots.caption: Problem 1: Boston gets about 49 inches of snow a year.

shots.narration: Problem two. Stanford is about a quarter the size of Boston.
shots.image: Photorealistic vertical aerial photograph looking straight down on Boston in winter from a high drone, the Charles River winding through the frame, Back Bay brownstone blocks, bridges, a dusting of snow on rooftops, harbor water at the top edge, no text, no overlays.
shots.caption: Problem 2: Stanford is about a quarter the size of Boston.
shots.calc: 8,353 acres (Stanford Facts 2025, fact v01.f.acres) / 30,940 acres (Boston land area 48.34 sq mi, 2020 US Census) = 27%, i.e. about a quarter

shots.narration: Problem three. Harvard and MIT are now its neighbors.
shots.image: Realistic wide photograph along the Charles River in winter: on the left bank Stanford's sandstone Hoover Tower with a cardinal red banner, across the river MIT's great dome with a grey banner and Harvard's red-brick tower with a crimson banner, students on each side glaring at each other across the frozen river.
shots.caption: Problem 3: Harvard and MIT are now its neighbors.

shots.narration: So the campus gets rebuilt for New England.
shots.image: Realistic photograph of Stanford's Hoover Tower surrounded by a campus rebuilt in New England style: red-brick buildings with steep slate roofs, white trim, bare maple trees, construction scaffolding and a snowplow clearing the quad, workers in winter gear, overcast winter afternoon.

shots.narration: Same Hoover Tower. Completely different Stanford.
shots.image: Realistic photograph of Stanford's Hoover Tower from the same low angle in deep winter snow in Boston, brick buildings and bare trees around it, grey sky, snow falling.

A college student in a puffy winter coat, beanie and scarf stands in front of snowy Hoover Tower in Boston, giving a confused shrug with a small smile, snow falling, warm window lights behind, realistic photo.
